skills.description: Trace which results, contracts and artifacts a change may invalidate, and state what was not traced. Use after changing preprocessing, data, parameters, metrics, baselines, prompts or evaluation code.
skills.name: change-impact

skills.description: Ship container images after auditing build contexts and compose files, then record and verify the bundle. Use before shipping images.

skills.description: Upgrade a pinned dependency with parity harnesses, a record and approval before the pins move. Use before changing a pin.

skills.description: Build every figure and table with a declared script from declared inputs, record the build, and keep displays cited and current. Use when making or changing a figure or table.

skills.name: manuscript-review

skills.name: number-crosscheck

skills.name: paper-kit

skills.description: Build slides in Beamer from an approved talk plan, with numbers and figures from the shared evidence and the presenter's style preferences. Use when creating or revising slides.
skills.name: presentation-building

skills.description: Plan a talk from its confirmed research stage, purpose, audience, duration and feedback intent before building slides. Use when preparing any presentation, poster or demo.
skills.name: presentation-planning

skills.description: Review a talk for stage-consistent claims, overstatement and understatement, audience fit and feedback intent, keeping objective check results apart from advice. Use before presenting or when asked to review slides.
skills.name: presentation-review

skills.description: Record closest prior methods, comparisons, claimed differences and distinguishing experiments; never judge novelty. Use when claiming a contribution, choosing baselines, writing related work, or after a failed experiment.
skills.name: prior-work-grounding

skills.description: Audit a project's progress and usefulness when the human says "Progress Audit" - evidence from steward audit progress, ranked improvements, then an offer to plan a sprint with its signatures.
skills.name: progress-audit

skills.description: Run and record an independent adversarial review before a release, with findings, regression tests and re-verification kept separate from fixing. Use before any public release or when asked to red-team a repository.
skills.name: red-team-review

skills.description: Keep literature reviews, novelty maps, gap and flaw lists and dead-end reviews as checkable records. Use for a literature review, a novelty or overlap check, gaps or flaws, or negative results.
skills.name: research-review

skills.description: State count, duration, memory, disk and cost before a run, with the basis; compare with actuals after. Use before long, heavy or paid computations.
skills.name: run-estimate

skills.description: Sign substantive work with date, harness, provider and exact model ID; unknowns stay unknown. Use when finishing a document, report, task, review or commit message.
skills.name: signature-and-attribution

skills.description: Prepare a preprint, conference or journal submission with final-mode checks, the venue checklist and a clean package. Use when a paper is close to submission or a deadline.
skills.name: submission-readiness

skills.description: Spec, hold for a recorded GO, implement, get independent review, never self-approve. Use when starting, implementing or reviewing a task, or when a human grants or withholds a go-ahead.
skills.name: task-lifecycle
